newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed on OTC market.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed on OTC market.

text.p: Following is the closing report for Croatia's over-the-counter securities market in Varazdin on Tuesday, October 15.
* Three of 12 active issues rose, three fell and six were unchanged.
* Volume higher at 3,348 shares, of which 1,430 were unpaid. Turnover 208,563 German marks.
* Top gainer was shipper Jadroplov, rising 46.34 percent to 60 marks on volume of 145 shares.
* Hotelier Jadranturist was the biggest loser, down 9.09 percent to 100 marks with 222 units sold.
* Most actively traded with 1,206 units was textile firm Varteks, flat at 40 marks.
